question: FIH Asia Cup Men’s Hockey 2022 was hosted by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• FIH Asia Cup Men's Hockey 2022 was hosted by Indonesia in the city of Jakarta.
 
• The tournament took place from May 23 to June 1, 2022.
 
• This was the eleventh edition of the Men's Hockey Asia Cup.
 
• Indonesia had the opportunity to host this prestigious tournament, showcasing its capability to organize international sports events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIH Asia Cup:**

 
 
• The Men's Hockey Asia Cup is an international men's field hockey tournament organized by the Asian Hockey Federation (AHF).
 
• The tournament was first held in 1982 in Karachi, Pakistan.
 
• The Asia Cup serves as a qualifier for the FIH Hockey World Cup, with the winner securing a spot in the prestigious global event.
 
• India and Pakistan have been the most successful teams in the tournament's history, each winning multiple titles.
 
 
 
• **Field Hockey:**
 
 
• Field hockey is a team sport played on grass or artificial turf, where players aim to score goals by hitting a ball into the opponent's net using a curved stick.
 
• It is one of the oldest team sports, with origins tracing back to ancient civilizations such as Egypt, Greece, and Persia.
 
• The modern game of field hockey was developed in the 19th century in England.
 
• The sport is governed by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) at the global level.
 
 
 
• **Asian Hockey Federation (AHF):**
 
 
• The AHF is the governing body for the sport of field hockey in Asia.
 
• It was established in 1958 and is responsible for organizing various continental tournaments, including the Asia Cup, Asian Games, and Asian Champions Trophy.
 
• The AHF works to promote and develop the sport of field hockey across its member countries.
 
• It is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
